observations.posthog_connection: Prevents silent accumulation of duplicate records when Checkout.com regenerates overlapping reports without the business key columns.

observations.behavior: Sorts report files by their ID to establish deterministic read order (oldest first).
observations.posthog_connection: Ensures that among multiple restatements of an action across daily files, the newest copy wins during warehouse merge operations.

observations.behavior: Disables datetime-based partitioning for tables keyed on business identifiers instead of file position.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse merges to match restated rows regardless of which day's report they appear in, preventing insertion of duplicates into different partitions.

review.posthog_relevance: Relevant to PostHog’s warehouse connector and data integrity. Could reduce customer support incidents related to double-counted financial actions if this integration is used.
